local function GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer, maxAngle)
    maxAngle = maxAngle or 60

    if not targetPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return nil end

    local targetLook = targetHRP.CFrame.LookVector

    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p ~= targetPlayer and p.Character then
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local difference = hrp.Position - targetHRP.Position

                if difference.Magnitude > 0 then

                    local dot = math.clamp(targetLook:Dot(vec), -1, 1)
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(dot))

                    if angle <= maxAngle then
                        local dist = difference.Magnitude

-- The decorative Star Platinum and menacing images are children of mainFrame,

do
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart = Vector2.new()
    local startPos = mainFrame.Position

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            -- Don't drag when clicking controls or decorative images.
            if input.Target == closeBtn
                or input.Target == guiToggle
                or input.Target == targetBox
                or input.Target == standBtn
                or input.Target == punchBtn
                or input.Target == posBox
                or input.Target == offBox
                or input.Target == heightBox then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = mainFrame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if dragging then
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local delta = mousePos - dragStart

            local newX = math.clamp(
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                0,
                workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X - mainFrame.Size.X.Offset
            )

            local newY = math.clamp(
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y,
                0,
                workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y - mainFrame.Size.Y.Offset
            )

            mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, newX, 0, newY)
        end
    end)
end

    local start = tick()

        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local c = player.Character

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

                + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

    end

        return
    end

    local lowerMessage = message:lower()

        otherPlayer.Name:lower():find(targetName:lower())

    if not targetMatches then
        return
    end

    if standOn and lowerMessage:find("barrage") then
        punchTarget()
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("block")
        and standOn
        and not vanished
        and not blocking then

        blocking = true
        SendChatMessage("BLOCK")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("unblock")
        and standOn
        and blocking then

        blocking = false
        SendChatMessage("UNBLOCK")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("vanish")
        and standOn
        and not vanished then

        vanished = true

        savedCharacterCFrame =
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        savedCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject

        humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
            CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                humanoidRootPart.Position.Z
            )

        local target =
            findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if target and target.Character then
            local targetHumanoid =
                target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if targetHumanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = targetHumanoid
            end
        end

        SendChatMessage("Yare Yare Daze")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("summon") then

        if blocking then
            blocking = false
        end

        if vanished then
            vanished = false

            if savedCharacterCFrame
                and humanoidRootPart
                and humanoidRootPart.Parent then

                humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
                    savedCharacterCFrame
            end

            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

            if humanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
            elseif savedCameraSubject then
                camera.CameraSubject = savedCameraSubject
            end

            savedCharacterCFrame = nil
            savedCameraSubject = nil

            SendChatMessage("Star Platinum, Toki wo Tomare")
            return
        end

        standOn = not standOn

        standBtn.Text =
            standOn
            and "「 STAND: ON 」"
            or "「 STAND: OFF 」"

        if standOn then
            enableStand()

            local t =
                findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

            if t
                and t.Character

                for _, id in ipairs(summonSoundIds) do

                    summon:Play()

                    Debris:AddItem(summon, 3)

            SendChatMessage("Star Platinum, Toki wo Tomare")
        else
            disableStand()
        end
    end

		Animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		Animator.Parent = Humanoid
	end

	local Animation =
		Instance.new("Animation")

	Animation.AnimationId =
		"rbxassetid://" .. tostring(ID)

	local Success, Track = pcall(function()
		return Animator:LoadAnimation(Animation)
	end)

	if Track then
		pcall(function()
			Track:Stop()
			Track:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	Animation:Destroy()

	return Success and Track ~= nil
end

local function PlayAnimation(Name, ID, Button, Looped)
	local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

	local Humanoid =
		Character and
		Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not Humanoid then
		return false
	end

	StopCurrentAnimation()

	local Animator =
		Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

	if not Animator then
		Animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		Animator.Parent = Humanoid
	end

	local Animation =
		Instance.new("Animation")

	Animation.AnimationId =
		"rbxassetid://" .. tostring(ID)

	local Success, Track = pcall(function()
		return Animator:LoadAnimation(Animation)
	end)

	Animation:Destroy()

	if not Success or not Track then
		return false
	end

	CurrentTrack = Track

	Track.Priority =
		Enum.AnimationPriority.Action

	Track.Looped = Looped == true

	local Played = pcall(function()
		Track:Play(0.15)
	end)

	if not Played then
		pcall(function()
			Track:Destroy()
		end)

		CurrentTrack = nil

		return false
	end

	Button.Text =
		"▶ " .. Name

	if not Track.Looped then
		Track.Stopped:Connect(function()

			if CurrentTrack == Track then
				CurrentTrack = nil
			end

			if Button.Parent then
				Button.Text = Name
			end
		end)
	else
		task.delay(0.8, function()

			if Button.Parent then
				Button.Text = Name
			end
		end)
	end

	return true
end

local CategoryLabels = {
	["Wave"] = "EMOTES",
	["Point"] = "EMOTES",

}

		Instance.new("TextLabel")

	Label.Size =
		UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 30)

	Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	Label.Text =
		"── " .. Name .. " ──"

	Label.TextColor3 =
		Color3.fromRGB(100, 170, 255)

	Label.TextSize = 14

	Label.Font =
		Enum.Font.GothamBold

	Label.ZIndex = 15
	Label.Parent = AnimationScroll
end

for _, Data in ipairs(Animations) do

	task.spawn(function()

		local Name = Data[1]
		local ID = Data[2]
		local Looped = Data[3]

		-- Don't create the button if the animation
		-- cannot currently be loaded.
		if not CanLoadAnimation(ID) then
			return
		end

		local Category =
			CategoryLabels[Name] or "INTERACTIONS"

		if CurrentCategory ~= Category then
			CurrentCategory = Category
			CreateAnimationCategory(Category)
		end

		local Button =
			Instance.new("TextButton")

		Button.Size =
			UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 42)

		Button.BackgroundColor3 =
			Color3.fromRGB(42, 43, 52)

		Button.BorderSizePixel = 0

		Button.Text = Name

		Button.TextColor3 =
			Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

		Button.TextSize = 13

		Button.Font =
			Enum.Font.GothamBold

		Button.ZIndex = 15
		Button.Parent = AnimationScroll

		Instance.new(
			"UICorner",
			Button
		).CornerRadius =
			UDim.new(0, 8)

		Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

			if not PlayAnimation(
				Name,
				ID,
				Button,
				Looped
			) then

				Button:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)
end
]]

local AnimationPattern =
	'local Animations = {.-\nend\n\nfor _, Data in ipairs%(Animations%) do.-\nend'

local BeforeAnimations, AnimationCount =
	Source:gsub(
		AnimationPattern,

	)

if AnimationCount == 1 then
	Source = BeforeAnimations
else

end

			if CopyProfileButton.Parent then

					"Copy Profile Link Roblox"
			end
		end)
	end
end)

]]

	'RefreshPlayers%(%)[\r\n]+%-%-====================================================[\r\n]+%-%- TAB SYSTEM',
	'RefreshPlayers()\n' .. CreditsCode ..

CreditsTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	SelectTab(CreditsPage, CreditsTab, "Credits")

	1

	loadstring(Source)

if not Execute then
	warn("Failed to compile patched GUI:")
	warn(CompileError)
	return
end

	pcall(Execute)

if not RuntimeSuccess then
	warn("Patched GUI encountered an error:")
	warn(RuntimeError)
	return
end
